title: Idempotent completeness of the rationalized category
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] $p,a,q,k_0,k$ with $q=p^a$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and a finite extension $E/\Ql$ contained in $\Qlb$, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Y$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $D^b_c(Y,E)$ be the raw rationalized category of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Then $D^b_c(Y,E)$ is idempotent complete, and the canonical functor

$$
 D^b_c(Y,E)\longrightarrow\Kar\bigl(D^b_c(Y,E)\bigr)
$$

into its Karoubi envelope [def-weil-karoubi-envelope] is an exact equivalence.

proof.text: Put $\mathcal T=D^b_c(Y,E)$. By [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], this is the triangulated raw scalar localization of the derived-complete integral category, without formally adjoining any retracts. Apply [prop-constructible-truncations] with the fixed finite-field datum, the given finite extension $E\subset\Qlb$, the finite-type $k$-scheme $Y$, and $\Lambda=E$. Its asserted truncation functors, natural maps and distinguished truncation triangles give a bounded t-structure on precisely $\mathcal T$. Only its rational-stage bounded-t-structure assertion is used; no assertion about levelwise integral truncations or a comparison with a different coefficient category is needed.

source.place: ## Proof, opening bounded-t-structure assertion; expanded with the rational-stage statement of prop-constructible-truncations (order 2432)

proof.text: Apply [thm-weil-karoubian-bounded-t] to the triangulated category $\mathcal T$ and the bounded t-structure of step 1. This theorem supplies both assertions: every idempotent in $\mathcal T$ splits, and the canonical fully faithful functor $\mathcal T\to\Kar(\mathcal T)$ is an exact equivalence. By [def-weil-karoubi-envelope] that functor sends $K$ to $(K,\operatorname{id}_K)$ and acts identically on morphisms, so it is exactly the functor in the statement. In particular the conclusion concerns the raw rationalization itself, rather than merely the idempotent completeness of a formally enlarged category.

split_report.statement_dispute: The item says only "Y be a scheme", whereas its enclosing unit fixes a separated finite-type k-scheme and its named finite-stage theorem requires noetherian finite-dimensional schemes with ell invertible. The purported substitution T=Y fails, e.g. for Y=Spec(F_ell), and finite-type scope fails for an infinite disjoint union of Spec(k). The repaired statement exposes the finite-field datum, ell distinct from p, and finite-type k-scheme scope appropriate to the available rational-stage truncation theorem. These are explicit failed hypothesis checks, not claimed counterexamples to abstract idempotent completeness. No equality between the detailed integral category and the separate PBC category with compatible etale-origin witnesses is asserted.
